content: On-device Whisper on Android is technically proven (whisper.cpp via JNI/CMake; projects: Handy, whisper-mobile, F-Droid Whisper, Buzz, LocalMind JNI walkthrough) but these are all small OSS dictation/transcription utilities. No mainstream AI-clipping competitor (OpusClip, Vizard, Klap, quso.ai, 2short, Wisecut, CapCut) runs transcription or clipping on-device - all are cloud services. Privacy-first on-device clipping is therefore an unoccupied position in this category.
